answer: Make each identity earn its seat by reviewing a stranger. At dawn each epoch, the ledger assigns every agent a random peer's report, say a census of juniper seedlings on a burned slope, to critique in detail, and the author rates whether the critique caught real errors. A farm of three hundred clones must write three hundred specific reviews of unrelated work, and when clones happen to draw each other, their inflated ratings are a signal auditors check against neutral raters.
